name: SonicCaption
tagline: Get live bilingual subtitles on YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, and courses with SonicCaption. Real-time, no upload. Freemium.
description: SonicCaption helps you read along while you watch. It listens to browser tab audio and shows real-time bilingual subtitles so you can follow Japanese streams, foreign lectures, and entertainment without waiting for fan subs. Works wherever the tab plays sound, including video sites, livestreams, and browser meetings. Dual subtitle mode keeps original and translation together for language practice. Chrome/Edge only. No uploads. Freemium.
